newsitem.title: USA: US domestic auto sales up 1.5 pct Feb 1-10-CNW.
newsitem.headline: US domestic auto sales up 1.5 pct Feb 1-10-CNW.

text.p: U.S. domestic auto sales rose 1.5 percent in the 10-day period February 1-10 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a CNW Marketing/Research report released Wednesday.
Domestic car sales advanced 1.5 percent, to 162,318 from 159,867, CNW said. Domestic truck sales increased 1.6 percent, to 141,876 from 139,687, it said.
Import car sales fell 1.8 percent to 32,603, and import truck sales gained 0.6 percent to 8,316, the report said.
Almost 1.3 million vehicles were sold in the United States year-to-date, down 2.3 percent from the same period in 1996.
